heroHeadline: Pakistan–Taliban Border Fighting Continues in Kurram–Paktia
heroSubtitle: Pakistani and Taliban forces traded fire for about four hours on October 17 across the Kurram–Paktia border, part of clashes ongoing since mid-October. Each side blames the other and casualty claims are disputed, with no active mediator after China's effort reportedly collapsed.
